description: Fail-closed registry for every GitHub Actions write capability. Branch writers require an active machine-distinguishable writer lease and exact-head CAS; unregistered writes and mutable action refs are forbidden.

deploy.purpose: Promote the exact same-run candidate built by the read-only readiness job to GitHub Pages
deploy.repositoryBoundary: same repository; candidate and witness artifacts must belong to this exact workflow run
deploy.branchBoundary: control-plane SHA equals current main; release SHA equals it automatically or is an explicit historical main ancestor

record.purpose: Record an idempotent capability witness for one exact successful Pages deploy run
record.repositoryBoundary: same repository deploy run resolved through the Actions API
record.branchBoundary: main deployment control-plane SHA plus independently verified release SHA
mutationTargets: machine-marked deployment witness issue or pull-request thread

witness.purpose: Record one idempotent Diotrophes live-route capability witness after an exact successful canonical Pages deployment
witness.repositoryBoundary: same repository successful Deploy to GitHub Pages run plus its exact generic live PASS artifact
witness.branchBoundary: main deployment control-plane SHA; route evidence must remain bound to the generic report release SHA and candidate digest
mutationTargets: exact release pull-request thread carrying the machine-marked Diotrophes capability witness

lifecycle.purpose: Open, update, recover, and fail-closed retire one factual CI incident per workflow and branch or pull request identity
lifecycle.repositoryBoundary: same repository workflow_run metadata; triggering branch code is never executed
lifecycle.branchBoundary: notifier implementation fetched from the trusted default branch; retirement runs only after successful Shared Files Guard on the default branch
mutationTargets: machine-marked CI failure lifecycle issues, including not_planned retirement receipts for proven inactive identities

placement-autofix.purpose: Apply deterministic glossary, tooltip, and asset-revision normalization to an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request
placement-autofix.branchBoundary: immutable queued PR head plus active owner-token/generation lease; final push is CAS-bound to the same expected head
mutationTargets: pull-request source branch glossary and tooltip normalization

headline-autofix.purpose: Normalize registered article document titles to their canonical social and structured-data headline on an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request
headline-autofix.branchBoundary: immutable queued PR head plus active owner-token/generation lease; final push is CAS-bound to the same expected head
mutationTargets: registered article PageHead title text on the pull-request source branch

search-manifest-autofix.purpose: Apply deterministic search-manifest and RSS normalization to an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request
search-manifest-autofix.branchBoundary: immutable queued PR head plus active owner-token/generation lease; final push is CAS-bound to the same expected head
mutationTargets: feed.xml and route/search policy manifests on the pull-request source branch

scripture-occurrence-autofix.purpose: Regenerate the deterministic Scripture occurrence index for an explicitly labelled same-repository pull request using the canonical source-owned generator
scripture-occurrence-autofix.branchBoundary: immutable queued PR head plus active owner-token/generation lease; final push is CAS-bound to the same expected head
mutationTargets: data/scripture-search-index.json on the pull-request source branch

branch-zero-autofix.purpose: Delete only the explicitly enumerated, pre-audited terminal branch refs and retire the temporary cleanup branch
branch-zero-autofix.branchBoundary: frozen main 998cd60759c535af0f542c31d5fc8e2948440c02 plus immutable queued cleanup head; target and self deletions are SHA-leased
